tasks.title: Thrust from a raw sample with drift correction
tasks.solution: The zero in the middle of the run: z = z0 + dz/2. Thrust T = (raw − z)/k. Without the drift correction the error is dz/(2k), a few grams, comparable with the vibration noise.

tasks.title: Thrust coefficient from stand data
tasks.solution: T in newtons = t/1000·g; n = rpm/60 rev/s; D = d·0.0254 m. C_T = T/(ρ·n²·D⁴). For the T-Motor 15×5 it comes out around 0.08; a constant C_T across the points checks the thrust and RPM channels.

tasks.title: Prop figure of merit
tasks.solution: A = π·D²/4, D = d·0.0254 m; T = t/1000·g; P_id = T^1.5/√(2ρA); FM = P_id/P_shaft. Good copter props give 0.6–0.75; if you use the electrical power instead of P_shaft, you get FM·η of the drive.
